review_candidates.title: Events, Brand Activation & PR Specialist
review_candidates.description: JOB PURPOSE The Events, Brand Activation & PR Specialist joins our Marketing Department at the Stabio (Ticino) headquarter. Reporting to the Global Sports & Events Manager (the Manager) and working closely with the cross-functional teams (Content & Campaigns, Social Media, Trade Marketing & Sales), the Specialist coordinates and executes the 360 calendar of Brand events, following the direction and priorities set by the Manager. The calendar covers main Equity events (such as special launch activations or the ambassadors summit), cycling fairs (indoor and outdoor) and community initiatives (mainly, but not limited to, social rides). The Specialist supports the Manager in preparing the events calendar and budget recommendations, plans the on-the-ground execution and tracks the KPIs. This role contributes directly to ASSOS community building, a key pillar of the 2027 brand strategy and a main driver of Equity appeal and visibility across target groups. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES The Manager owns the events grid, the budget and the Collective 13 concept. The Specialist supports their definition and is responsible for planning, coordination and execution within them. The role covers three areas. Commercial events: cycling fairs Work closely with the ISE and Sales teams so that fairs are executed in synergy with the commercial scope while staying aligned with the brand image. Support the Manager in preparing the events grid proposal with Sales, gathering the inputs needed (dates, locations, costs, past results). Maintain the overall fair calendar and coordinate the pre-validation of fair projects with the teams involved. Coordinate on-the-ground execution (logistics, suppliers, materials, schedule) and support brand activation where relevant. Proactively flag risks and propose solutions to the Manager. Social rides programme: Collective 13 Coordinate the day-to-day running of Collective 13, working closely with the Manager on the concept, priorities and budget they set. Prepare the project architecture for the Manager's approval: clusters of rides, goodies needs and timeline. Coordinate with the Branding & Style team on the special jersey scope and potential goodies design, following the Manager's brief. Coordinate with the Sales team to align the ride calendar, geographic priorities and commercial package follow-up. Coordinate the content side of the social rides, with the Manager's support, working with the Content & Campaigns and Social Media teams. Keep regular contact with the SBOs and be present on the ground to make sure the ride calendar is implemented and executed. Track KPIs and costs and report them to the Manager. PR core activities Support the planning of PR campaigns: press communication for key launches, including gathering copy and creative assets, ordering products and organising shipments. Coordinate the logistics of key PR events (media camps, races, drop launches). Once the calendar and concepts are agreed with the Marketing team and approved by the Manager, build a project plan for each event with key actions, owners, timings and next steps. Coordinate key stakeholders (Creative team, Product team, Warehouse) so that execution is timely and within budget. Liaise with the PR community (PR agencies, journalists, media partners) under the Manager's guidance and build a strong knowledge of ASSOS products to showcase them effectively. Across all areas Track spending and time precisely, within the budget set by the Manager, and flag deviations early. Take part in periodic alignments with the cross-functional Marketing team and prepare recap presentations or files to support regular updates to Management. REQUIREMENTS: 2-3 years of experience in event and community management. Good knowledge of cycling culture and events, combined with strong professionalism and a mature approach Proactive and smart mindset Solution-oriented mindset, Works well as part of a team and independently Solid organizational, communication and planning skills English speaking; Italian is a plus Frequent weekend travel, about 30% of the time during peak season (April to August), mainly in Europe A base in the HQ in Stabio, Ticino (Switzerland) , with 25% flexible smart working permitted. What you will learn Community and PR are key pillars of the ASSOS of Switzerland Marketing strategy. From community vision and activation to events planning, from event-related content production to coordination with the on-the-ground sales team, you will get a 360 overview of the key marketing areas and gain substantial experience working across all of them. In our Marketing team we encourage proactivity and initiative, and we love new ideas that push ASSOS visibility, hype and relevance with our consumers. You will be coached towards strong project leadership and a friendly yet efficient way of getting the job done. We love our brand, and we feel every project we bring to life can contribute to the Company's success, even at the most granular level. About ASSOS of Switzerland We are a leader, performance-driven cycling apparel brand committed to innovation, quality, and sustainability. Our products are trusted by cyclists worldwide, and we pride ourselves on pushing boundaries — not just in design, but also in how we operate as a business. Disclaimer: We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law.

This role integrates design intent with field execution , orchestrates multi-disciplinary teams, manages risk, and delivers auditable commissioning evidence that enables on-time, on-budget, and right-first-time facility readiness. The successful candidate will need to possess a strong understanding of HVAC systems, chilled water plants, industrial water systems, adiabatic cooling, CRAC/CRAH units, hydronic distribution, fuel oil systems, building management systems (BMS), fire protection systems, water treatment plants, and administration and logistics buildings . In addition, they will need to lead multi-disciplinary teams under tight deadlines and high-pressure conditions, while maintaining accurate commissioning records and turnover packages shared with Fleet leadership. This person will attend all commissioning meetings, track schedule adherence, issue closure rates, and system performance metrics. Job Responsibilities The successful candidate will have experience and practical expertise in the following: Planning & coordination: Review Basis of Design (BoD), drawings, specifications, and submittals for commissioning requirements and testability. Review and collaborate on sequences of operation (SOO) with design and controls teams; ensure sensor placement, access, and valving support for commissioning and future operations. Development and/or assist with the development and upkeep of the Commissioning Plan (scope, phasing, staffing, RASIC, tools, documentation control, quality gates). Define mechanical commissioning schedule aligned with construction and IST milestones; identify long-lead equipment and factory witness tests. Develop and/or assist with the development of Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 commissioning checklists. Develop and/or assist in the development of Level 4 and Level 5 commissioning test scripts. Commissioning Operations & Execution: Be responsible for commissioning team communications and updates, including leading or co-leading meetings. Oversee and/or lead Site Acceptance, Installation, and Pre-energization inspections, checklists, required documentation provided by contractors and vendors and issue resolution. Oversee and/or lead first time energization, pre-functional checklists (PFCs), start-up acceptance testing (SAT), and functional test scripts (FTs) for mechanical equipment and systems across all modes (normal, degraded, failover, emergency, maintenance bypass, recovery), including required documentation provided by contractors and vendors and issue resolution. Oversee vendor/OEM Level – 3 start-ups; verify conformance to submittals and sequences of operation (SOO). Oversee and coordinate TAB (Testing, Adjusting, Balancing) strategy, prerequisites, witnessing, and final report acceptance. Validate BMS point-to-point, alarm priorities, trending, graphics, and historian; ensure controls narratives are executable and traceable. Oversee and/or lead the plan and execution load bank testing, thermal validation protocols (as applicable), and performance testing to prove capacity and stability. Drive Integrated Systems Testing (IST) readiness and execution with electrical and life safety teams, ensuring mechanical responses and interlocks perform per design intent. Ensure project commissioning schedules are being met. Regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear, and smell. Frequently required to sit, climb, and balance. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, basic color differentiation and the ability to adjust focus. Regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Documentation & Turnover: Maintain a controlled repository within the Commissioning Platform for commissioning artifacts: SAI, Installation, PFCs, SATs, FPTs, IST results, issues logs, RFIs, redlines, and sign-offs. Review and/or produce consolidated Commissioning Reports with executive summaries, data visuals, narratives, and appendices. Assist with assembling Turnover Packages: final SOO, as-builts, TAB report, O&M manuals, warranties, spare parts lists, PM matrices, and training materials. Oversee and coordinate operator training and verify knowledge transfer (sign-in records and demonstration or assessment). Team Leadership & Development: Serve as the primary point of contact for mechanical commissioning scope; build trusted relationships with clients, GC/CMs, sub-contractors, vendors, and operations. Communicate progress, challenges, and solutions to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders; lead regular meetings and readiness reviews. Collaborate closely with pre-construction, design, construction, and operations teams to ensure seamless transition from construction to steady-state operations. Safety & Compliance: Operate safely in a fast pace, multi-phase construction atmosphere. Enforce lockout/tagout (LOTO), hot work permits, confined space, working at heights, and chemical handling protocols. Ensure compliance with applicable codes and standards (e.g., ASHRAE guidelines, NFPA where applicable, local/state mechanical codes). Conduct Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs) and pre-task plans; use proper PPE; lead daily toolbox talks during commissioning peaks. Champion safety culture and environmental compliance across all commissioning activities. Financial & Performance Management: Manage commissioning budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation to ensure cost-efficient delivery. Establish and track KPIs: schedule adherence (% milestones achieved), defect density & closure rate (issues per MW; time-to-close), test coverage (% completed vs planned), performance compliance (% systems meeting OPR/BoD tolerances), handover quality (turnover completeness; operator training satisfaction), and safety outcomes (TRIR, near-miss reporting). Drive operational excellence to meet corporate targets and deliver projects on time and within budget. Required Qualifications 8+ years of mechanical commissioning experience in mission-critical facilities (data centers, hospitals, labs, pharma, or industrial) Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related field In lieu of degree, Graduate of applicable Commissioning Technical school or military with relevant military electrical or technical experience AND (8) years minimum commissioning work experience. Proven track record leading functional testing and IST coordination, with strong SCADA/controls/BMS integration and TAB familiarity. Demonstrates the ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams in high-stakes startup and cutover windows. Exceptional organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills, with strong documentation discipline. Excellent written and verbal communication and stakeholder management skills; proficiency with project management and commissioning platforms. review_candidates.title: Business Development Executive – B2B Sales
review_candidates.description: We're Hiring: Business Development Executive – B2B Sales Company: Global Screening Services (GSS) Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 1–3 Years Compensation: ₹3–4 LPA (Fixed + Performance-Based Incentives) About Global Screening Services Global Screening Services (GSS) is a background verification company providing comprehensive employee screening and verification solutions to organisations across industries. Our services help companies make informed hiring decisions through employment verification, education verification, address verification, identity verification, criminal record checks and other background screening services. Website: https://www.globalscreeningservices.in The Opportunity We are looking for a confident, articulate and result-oriented  Business Development Executive  to join our growing sales team. This is a complete B2B sales and client acquisition role. The individual will be responsible for identifying prospective corporate clients, initiating conversations through outbound calls, pitching GSS's services, following up with prospects, negotiating and ultimately converting them into paying clients. The candidate will be provided with an initial database of prospective companies and contacts that is updated on a weekly basis. However, they will also be expected to independently research and generate new leads, identify relevant decision-makers and continuously build their own sales pipeline. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the entire sales process, from the first phone call to successfully acquiring a new client. Key Responsibilities 1. Outbound Sales & Client Acquisition Make outbound calls to prospective corporate clients from the database provided by the company. Introduce Global Screening Services and pitch our background verification solutions. Connect with HR Heads, HR Managers, Talent Acquisition Managers, Recruitment Heads and other relevant decision-makers. Understand prospective clients' requirements and identify business opportunities. Effectively communicate the value and benefits of GSS's services. Convert prospective customers into active corporate clients. 2. Lead Generation & Database Building Independently identify companies that may require employee background verification services. Research and build databases of prospective corporate clients. Identify relevant decision-makers and obtain their professional contact information. Use LinkedIn, company websites, business directories and other online platforms for prospect research. Continuously expand the company's potential client base. 3. Sales Pitching, Follow-ups & Negotiations Conduct sales discussions with prospective clients. Explain service offerings, pricing structures and commercial terms. Handle objections, address queries and negotiate within approved commercial guidelines. Prepare and share quotations and proposals. Conduct consistent follow-ups to move prospects through the sales pipeline. Independently drive sales discussions towards successful closure. 4. Client Onboarding & Relationship Management Coordinate with newly acquired clients during the initial onboarding process. Ensure a smooth handover to the operations team. Build and maintain professional relationships with acquired clients. Identify opportunities for repeat business and account growth. 5. Sales Reporting & Performance Tracking Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, follow-ups and conversions. Regularly update the company's sales database/CRM. Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance. Work towards achieving assigned lead generation, client acquisition and revenue targets. Candidate Requirements Excellent English-speaking skills are mandatory.  The candidate must be fluent, articulate and confident when communicating in English. Strong verbal communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Confidence in speaking with senior corporate professionals over the phone. Strong persuasion, negotiation and objection-handling abilities. A proactive approach towards cold calling and B2B sales. Ability to independently research companies and generate new business leads. Strong follow-up, organisational and relationship management skills. Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and internet research.  Self-motivated, target-oriented and driven by business development and revenue generation. Experience & Qualifications 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, inside sales, telecalling or client acquisition is preferred. Experience in selling HR services, recruitment solutions, staffing, SaaS or other corporate services will be an advantage. Graduates preferred. Freshers with exceptional English communication skills, confidence and a strong aptitude for sales are welcome to apply. Compensation Fixed Salary: ₹25,000–₹32,00 per month, depending on experience and suitability. Additional performance-based incentives for successful client acquisition and revenue generation. Opportunity to grow into a larger business development and account management role. Who Should Apply? We are looking for someone who is genuinely interested in sales and business development. Someone who: Is comfortable picking up the phone and initiating conversations with complete strangers. Can confidently pitch services to corporate decision-makers. Has the ability to convince, negotiate and close deals. Does not depend entirely on company-provided leads and can generate their own prospects. Takes ownership of targets and is motivated by achieving business results. This is not a conventional telecalling position. We are looking for an individual who can independently generate leads, pitch, convert prospects and bring new corporate business to GSS. How to Apply Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn with their updated resume or get in touch with humanresources@globalscreeningservices.co.in with the subject line "Business Development Executive – B2B Sales" Important:  Excellent spoken English and confidence in communicating with corporate clients are essential selection criteria. We look forward to welcoming a driven sales professional to the GSS team!
